layout: row-major, width × height nodes; value k = j·width + i is the height at world (x = minX + i·cellSize, z = minZ + j·cellSize); i → east, j → south
source: AWS Terrain Tiles (terrarium), zoom 14, bilinear; ground-dem: blurred 45 m where buildings stand
attribution: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen / AWS Open Data, github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md): EU-DEM – produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union; SRTM – NASA / USGS
